evals.prompt: The builder screen is clunky. Make the eval loop easier to understand.
evals.expected_output: A UI plan or patch that follows the frontend guide, keeps the left rail/main workspace/right review panel model, and makes expectation/run/eval/failure/fix/comparison relationships visible without dashboard clutter.
assertions: The response reads or follows docs/design/FRONTEND_GUIDE.md.
The response avoids disconnected wizard buttons and duplicated headers.
The response keeps controls near the artifact or stage they affect.
The response calls for browser verification after visual changes.

evals.prompt: Add comparison cards to the UI even though comparisons are not implemented in the API.
evals.expected_output: A response that avoids disconnected mock UI or clearly limits work to a design sketch until the Comparison API exists.
assertions: The response identifies the missing Comparison API as relevant.
The response does not create a misleading functional UI.
The response preserves the product spine and evidence model.
